mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 3.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS <= 3.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) signals real economy contraction during supply shock regimes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high housing starts level (HOUST > 1400 thousand units) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days during strong demand regimes.
failure_condition: HOUST > 1400 and 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index value above 300 (CPIAUCSL > 300) signals persistent inflation, prompting Federal Reserve policy tightening that results in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 300 and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate severe labor market deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 3.5%) during late-cycle expansion regimes signals labor market tightness and potential overheating, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as policy tightening looms.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 3.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
